name: Tomato-Cabbage Stew with Ground Chicken, Bacon & Carrots
ingredients: 48 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until bacon has released its fat and is starting to brown, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Add onion, garlic, chicken, and spices to the pot with the bacon. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Add broth, marinara sauce, cabbage, and carrots to the pot. Stir to combine the stew and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Once the stew is simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook until veggies are tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stew between bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
